messages:
maria: Heads-up: proposing sampling-based TTL + SLA attenuation for marketplace usage ingestion to reduce noise from <1min spikes from HW partners. TL;DR: keep 72h TTL for per-device hourly aggregates, but sample low-volume partners at 10% after 48h. Trying to align w/ billing window and entitlements. Thoughts?
kevin: Can you sketch the fallback rules? what happens for disputes / audits?
maria: Fallback: store full raw for 7 days, sampled aggregates for 30d, TTL for non-billable partners 48h. For disputes we rehydrate from raw if within 7d. Will need partner opt-in flag. Example config:
```yaml
sampling_rule:
  window: 1h
  ttl_nonbillable: 48h
  raw_retention: 168h # 7d
  sample_rate: 0.10
  audit_mode: false
```
anika: Opt-in flag might be hard w/ marketplace contracts. Need ops + legal 👀. Also how do we advertise to partner portal?
sam: From infra: sampling at the ingest layer is cheap, but rehydrate path needs to be tested for peak egress. We'll need a canary on 5 partners first.
partner-bot: New ticket created: MKT-732 sampling-ttl-implement (<https://redwood.internal/tickets/MKT-732>)
maria: Agree canary. Proposal: 3-phase: 1) implement config + tests, 2) canary w/ 5 partners (non-prod then prod), 3) roll to all partners with SLA attenuation policy. I'll draft runbook.
kevin: :thumbsup: add 'audit mode' flag so billing team can toggle full retention per-partner
sam: Noted. I can add a toggle in the ingest gateway. Rough perf estimate: +5% CPU for sampling, +20% for rehydrate paths during disputes.
anika: I'll loop in legal + partner success. Tagging @lena for billing policy confirm.
lena: Billing: need clear customer-facing language. We can't silently sample billed usage. Sampling only for telemetry / non-billable metrics.
maria: Yes — sampling only for non-billable telemetry. For billable events keep 100% retention. Updated plan: will share doc by EOD and schedule sync.
